headline: Get Luminelle
title: How to Get Luminelle | Wait For The Shooting Star | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Luminelle comes from the Bulbly line. Bulbly becomes Veilfloat at level forty two. Veilfloat becomes Luminelle at level fifty two, with one Roar Stone. You must also defeat Alpha Luminelle on Tideblossom Coast. Set the time to night, climb to the boss arena in the southeast, and watch the golden shooting star land. Miss it and you wait again. Did you catch the star? Comment below!
description: Aniimo's Luminelle evolves from Veilfloat at level 52 with one Roar Stone, after you defeat Alpha Luminelle on Tideblossom Coast at night.
